info.title: Logging facade setup for Maven Java project

diffs.patch:
Index: pom.xml
===================================================================
--- pom.xml	
+++ pom.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+
+    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
+    <artifactId>logging-facade-app</artifactId>
+    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
+    <packaging>jar</packaging>
+
+    <name>logging-facade-app</name>
+    <description>Maven project using SLF4J as a logging facade</description>
+
+    <properties>
+        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
+        <maven.compiler.release>17</maven.compiler.release>
+        <slf4j.version>2.0.13</slf4j.version>
+        <logback.version>1.5.6</logback.version>
+        <junit.version>5.10.2</junit.version>
+    </properties>
+
+    <dependencies>
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
+            <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>
+            <version>${slf4j.version}</version>
+        </dependency>
+
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>ch.qos.logback</groupId>
+            <artifactId>logback-classic</artifactId>
+            <version>${logback.version}</version>
+            <scope>runtime</scope>
+        </dependency>
+
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
+            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
+            <version>${junit.version}</version>
+            <scope>test</scope>
+        </dependency>
+    </dependencies>
+
+    <build>
+        <plugins>
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.13.0</version>
+            </plugin>
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.2.5</version>
+            </plugin>
+        </plugins>
+    </build>
+</project>

Index: src/main/resources/logback.xml
===================================================================
--- src/main/resources/logback.xml	
+++ src/main/resources/logback.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<configuration>
+    <appender name="STDOUT" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
+        <encoder>
+            <pattern>%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - %msg%n</pattern>
+        </encoder>
+    </appender>
+
+    <root level="INFO">
+        <appender-ref ref="STDOUT"/>
+    </root>
+</configuration>

- Group ID: com.example
- Artifact ID: logging-app (or similar)

Now create the Maven project. Let me create the todo list? It's a multi-step task but fairly straightforward. I'll use a short todo list maybe. Actually 4+ files. Let me just do it.

Let me pick package com.example.app.

pom.xml:
- modelVersion 4.0.0
- groupId com.example
- artifactId logging-facade-app
- version 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT
- properties: maven.compiler.release 17, project.build.sourceEncoding UTF-8, slf4j.version 2.0.13, logback.version 1.5.6, junit.version 5.10.2
- dependencies: slf4j-api, logback-classic (runtime scope? Usually compile so that it's available at test/runtime; for facade decoupling, app code should only import org.slf4j. Logback can be runtime scope to enforce compile-time absence). Best practice: set logback-classic with runtime scope so application code can't accidentally import it. Good demonstration.
- test: junit-jupiter, and for tests to see logs, logback runtime scope still on test classpath (runtime scope is included in test classpath). Good.
- build: maven-compiler-plugin, maven-surefire-plugin 3.2.5.

App.java logs something using LoggerFactory.

logback.xml in src/main/resources.

AppTest.java verifying logger.

Let me write.

input.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>logging-facade-app</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>logging-facade-app</name>
    <description>Maven project using SLF4J as a logging facade</description>

    <properties>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <maven.compiler.release>17</maven.compiler.release>
        <slf4j.version>2.0.13</slf4j.version>
        <logback.version>1.5.6</logback.version>
        <junit.version>5.10.2</junit.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>
            <version>${slf4j.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>ch.qos.logback</groupId>
            <artifactId>logback-classic</artifactId>
            <version>${logback.version}</version>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>${junit.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.13.0</version>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.5</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

Key point: app code imports only `org.slf4j` (the facade, `App.java:3-4`); Logback is the implementation and is scoped `runtime`, so the codebase physically can't hard-couple to it.

Build/run (Java 17+ and Maven required):
- `mvn clean package`
- `mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=com.example.App` (add `exec-maven-plugin` if you want that), or `java -jar target/...`
